{{Vanilla|Enchanted Book}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''Hell-Bound Book''' is the [[Matcha Flavoured]] name for the {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. A crafted Hell-Bound Book is the base of every [[blessing]]: it is surrounded with themed ingredients to make a book with fixed [[enchantment]]s. The name applies to every enchanted book, so blessings, [[Ofuda]] and enchanted books found in chests are all Hell-Bound Books underneath.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The crafted book stacks to 64 and stores [[Curse of Binding]] I.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/hell_bound_book.json}}</ref> Both other ingredients are magic materials: [[Stabilized Estus]] is itself crafted from seven [[Estus Ash]], a [[Benzene]] and a [[Stable Void]], so one book costs two Benzene in total.

=== Loot ===
Enchanted books are still found in many chests, in fishing treasure and through piglin bartering. These are ordinary enchanted books, so they also show the name "Hell-Bound Book". The Variant column gives their enchantment where the loot table fixes it. The enchanting table, which cannot be crafted in the pack, drops a Hell-Bound Book with no stored enchantments when broken, along with 2 [[diamond]]s and 4 obsidian.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/enchanting_table.json}}</ref> See also [[Enchanting#Other sources]].
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}
Every blessing recipe places the Hell-Bound Book in the center of the grid. The blessing that comes out stores only its own enchantments, not the Curse of Binding.

=== Anvil ===
A blank Hell-Bound Book can be combined with equipment in an [[anvil]] like any enchanted book, which applies its Curse of Binding to wearable equipment.

== Trivia ==
* The pack's English language file writes the name in red (the <code>§c</code> formatting code), so every enchanted book's name shows in red.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref>
* An enchanted book pulled up while fishing plays a custom "Caught a Hell-Bound Book" sound, and the [[Angler's Almanac]] has an entry for it: "A mysterious enchanted book pulled from the water. Hopefully the magic works better when dry."
